title: How To Run A Hospital | Yes Minister | BBC Comedy Greats
summary: A short Yes Minister clip in which Sir Humphrey explains why a hospital with no patients still needs a large administrative staff. It is a satirical look at bureaucratic bloat in the public sector.
why: HN commenters cite it as the canonical joke about administrators multiplying regardless of the work, whenever threads turn to institutional or corporate bloat.

quote.text: a conversation between the minister & his private secretary where the latter explains why administrators are essential no matter what
